integrity: A standalone standard-library checker verifies exact finite polynomial identities and supplementary numerical quadratures. Universal signs and root uniqueness are proved analytically. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact-degree-four real spherical harmonics on the two-sphere with two equal antipodal polar caps only. No all-degree, complex, nonantipodal, or low-pass-band claim. General Slepian concentration-matrix formulas are credited as prior art. Gilbert–Slepian 1977 could not be read in full, leaving a historical originality risk.
title: Five concentration phases and a fivefold resonance for quartic spherical harmonics in antipodal caps
